title: TransitJazz — The City's Rhythm (Prototype)
description: Recorded cohort distance over time, distance shares, and Movement & Music, using matched verified category hours. Missing history remains missing.

target.rawSql:
WITH
input AS (
    SELECT ${city:sqlstring}::text AS city_slug, ARRAY[${route:sqlstring}]::text[]::text[] AS route_keys,
           ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::timestamptz AS from_utc, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::timestamptz AS to_utc,
           'observed-city-route-hour-statistics-v1'::text AS supported_definition, CASE ${city:sqlstring} WHEN 'atlanta' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'washington-dc' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'boston' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'new-york-city' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'toronto' THEN 'America/Toronto' WHEN 'philadelphia' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'denver' THEN 'America/Denver' END::text AS local_zone
),
hours AS (
    SELECT h AS hour_start_utc,
           h >= i.from_utc AND h + interval '1 hour' <= i.to_utc AS fully_contained
    FROM (SELECT * FROM input WHERE to_utc > from_utc AND to_utc - from_utc <= interval '31 days' AND cardinality(route_keys) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        date_trunc('hour', i.from_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
        i.to_utc, interval '1 hour') AS g(h)
    WHERE h < i.to_utc
),
retained AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM public.city_route_hour_statistics s
    JOIN input i ON s.city_slug = i.city_slug
    JOIN hours h USING (hour_start_utc)
),
route_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT k AS route_join_key
    FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.route_keys) AS x(k)
    WHERE i.route_keys IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT s.route_join_key
    FROM public.city_route_hour_statistics s CROSS JOIN input i
    WHERE s.city_slug = i.city_slug AND i.route_keys IS NULL
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT h.hour_start_utc, h.fully_contained,
           count(s.route_join_key) AS retained_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'Complete') AS stored_complete_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'Partial') AS stored_partial_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'NoData') AS stored_no_data_route_count,
           coalesce(bool_or(s.has_conflict), false) AS city_hour_has_conflict,
           coalesce(bool_or(s.catalog_changed), false) AS city_hour_catalog_changed
    FROM hours h LEFT JOIN retained s USING (hour_start_utc)
    GROUP BY h.hour_start_utc, h.fully_contained
),
joined AS (
    SELECT i.city_slug AS requested_city, i.from_utc, i.to_utc,
           k.route_join_key AS requested_route_key, h.hour_start_utc AS requested_hour_utc,
           h.fully_contained, s.*,
           CASE WHEN s.hour_start_utc IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
                WHEN c.city_hour_has_conflict THEN 'Conflict'
                ELSE s.collection_status END AS effective_coverage,
           coalesce(s.definition_version = i.supported_definition, false) AS definition_compatible,
           coalesce(s.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone,
                    h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone) AS local_start,
           extract(epoch FROM ((h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone)
                             - (h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')))::integer AS utc_offset_seconds
    FROM route_keys k CROSS JOIN hours h CROSS JOIN input i
    JOIN cohorts c USING (hour_start_utc)
    LEFT JOIN retained s ON s.route_join_key = k.route_join_key
                       AND s.hour_start_utc = h.hour_start_utc
),
evidence AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           effective_coverage = 'Complete' AND fully_contained AND definition_compatible
               AS contributes
    FROM joined j
), names AS (
 SELECT k.route_join_key, (ARRAY['①','②','③','④','⑤'])[row_number() OVER (ORDER BY k.route_join_key COLLATE "C")] || ' ' || coalesce(n.route_short_name,k.route_join_key) || ' [' || k.route_join_key || ']' AS label,
 row_number() OVER (ORDER BY k.route_join_key COLLATE "C") AS color_slot
 FROM route_keys k LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT nullif(route_short_name,'') AS route_short_name FROM retained r
 WHERE r.route_join_key=k.route_join_key ORDER BY hour_start_utc DESC LIMIT 1
 ) n ON true
), eligible AS (
 SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE contributes AND distinct_active_vehicle_count IS NOT NULL
), matched AS (
 SELECT requested_hour_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
 FROM eligible GROUP BY requested_hour_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
 HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM route_keys)
), fingerprints AS (
 SELECT e.requested_hour_utc, m.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.requested_route_key,e.route_catalog_fingerprint,e.category,e.route_short_name,e.static_route_id)
 ORDER BY e.requested_route_key COLLATE "C")::text AS identity
 FROM eligible e JOIN matched m USING(requested_hour_utc,healthy_cadence_limit_seconds)
 GROUP BY e.requested_hour_utc,m.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
), changes AS (
 SELECT *, identity IS DISTINCT FROM lag(identity) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc)
 OR healthy_cadence_limit_seconds IS DISTINCT FROM lag(healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS changed
 FROM fingerprints
), segmented AS (
 SELECT *, sum(changed::integer) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS segment FROM changes
), segments AS (
 SELECT segment,min(requested_hour_utc) AS start_utc,max(requested_hour_utc)+interval '1 hour' AS end_utc,
 count(*) AS hours FROM segmented GROUP BY segment
), chosen AS (
 SELECT * FROM segments WHERE segment::text = ${route_segment:sqlstring}
 OR (${route_segment:sqlstring}='latest' AND segment=(SELECT max(segment) FROM segments))
), comparable AS (
 SELECT e.*, n.label,n.color_slot FROM eligible e
 JOIN segmented s USING(requested_hour_utc,healthy_cadence_limit_seconds)
 JOIN chosen c USING(segment) JOIN names n ON n.route_join_key=e.requested_route_key
 WHERE (SELECT count(DISTINCT healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) FROM matched)=1
), period AS (
 SELECT requested_route_key,label,color_slot,count(*) AS comparable_hours,
 min(requested_hour_utc) AS first_hour,max(requested_hour_utc)+interval '1 hour' AS end_hour,
 sum(distance_meters_sum)/1000 AS recorded_km,
 sum(distinct_active_vehicle_count::numeric) AS route_vehicle_hours,
 sum(distance_interval_count) AS accepted_intervals,
 sum(crossings_published_count::numeric)/count(*) AS opportunities,
 sum(active_vehicle_count_sum::numeric)/nullif(sum(valid_active_sample_count),0) AS vehicles,
 sum(distance_meters_sum) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)/1000 AS in_service_recorded_km,
 sum(distinct_active_vehicle_count::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_route_vehicle_hours,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_hours,
 (sum(active_vehicle_count_sum::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)) /
   nullif((sum(valid_active_sample_count::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)),0) AS in_service_vehicles,
 sum(distance_interval_count) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_accepted_intervals
 FROM comparable GROUP BY requested_route_key,label,color_slot
)
, transitions AS (
 SELECT requested_route_key,requested_hour_utc,route_catalog_fingerprint,
 lag(route_catalog_fingerprint) OVER (PARTITION BY requested_route_key ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS previous_fingerprint,
 lag(requested_hour_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY requested_route_key ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS previous_hour
 FROM evidence WHERE route_catalog_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT previous_hour+interval '1 hour' AS time,requested_hour_utc AS timeend,
 'Catalog transition: ' || requested_route_key || CASE WHEN requested_hour_utc>previous_hour+interval '1 hour'
 THEN ' (change time unknown across capture gap)' ELSE ' (observed boundary)' END AS text
 FROM transitions WHERE previous_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND previous_fingerprint<>route_catalog_fingerprint;

 WHERE city_slug=${city:sqlstring} AND category IN (${category:sqlstring})

options.content:
**${city:text}** · Follow the distance recorded by the transit ensemble, discover which cohorts carry the movement, and see how that movement relates to music.

Distance comes from accepted movement updates in complete hours shared by every selected type. Gaps stay missing; accumulated distance resumes from recorded hours only. Times are UTC.

panels.title: How far did the ensemble move?
panels.description: Sum of accepted along-route distance across matched verified hours, in kilometers. Observed cohort distance, not an estimate of unobserved travel. Policies remain separate.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_categories AS (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS selected_category),
reports AS (
    SELECT report.* FROM selected_categories selected
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
WITH minute_evidence AS (
    SELECT city_slug, category, definition_version,
           date_trunc('hour', stat_minute_utc, 'UTC') AS hour_start_utc,
           count(*) AS minute_count,
           bool_and(collection_status = 'Complete' AND NOT has_conflict) AS all_complete,
           min(healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) AS min_limit,
           max(healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) AS max_limit,
           sum(observed_cycle_count) AS observed_cycle_count,
           sum(valid_active_sample_count) AS valid_active_sample_count,
           sum(valid_publish_cycle_count) AS valid_publish_cycle_count,
           sum(failed_cycle_count) AS failed_cycle_count,
           sum(active_vehicle_count_sum) AS active_vehicle_count_sum,
           sum(distance_meters_sum) AS distance_meters_sum,
           sum(distance_interval_count) AS distance_interval_count,
           sum(distance_rejected_count) AS distance_rejected_count,
           sum(crossings_published_count) AS crossings_published_count
    FROM public.city_category_minute_statistics
    WHERE city_slug = ${city:sqlstring}
      AND category = selected.selected_category
      AND definition_version = 'observed-city-category-statistics-v1'
      AND stat_minute_utc >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
      AND stat_minute_utc < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)
    GROUP BY city_slug, category, definition_version,
             date_trunc('hour', stat_minute_utc, 'UTC')
), verified_hours AS (
    SELECT h.*
    FROM public.city_category_hour_statistics h
    JOIN minute_evidence m USING (city_slug, category, definition_version, hour_start_utc)
    WHERE h.city_slug = ${city:sqlstring} AND h.category = selected.selected_category
      AND h.definition_version = 'observed-city-category-statistics-v1'
      AND h.hour_start_utc >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
      AND h.hour_start_utc + interval '1 hour' <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)
      AND h.collection_status = 'Complete' AND NOT h.has_conflict
      AND h.covered_minutes = 60 AND h.distinct_active_vehicle_count IS NOT NULL
      AND m.minute_count = 60 AND m.all_complete
      AND m.min_limit = h.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
      AND m.max_limit = h.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
      AND m.observed_cycle_count = h.observed_cycle_count
      AND m.valid_active_sample_count = h.valid_active_sample_count
      AND m.valid_publish_cycle_count = h.valid_publish_cycle_count
      AND m.failed_cycle_count = h.failed_cycle_count
      AND m.active_vehicle_count_sum = h.active_vehicle_count_sum
      AND m.distance_meters_sum = h.distance_meters_sum
      AND m.distance_interval_count = h.distance_interval_count
      AND m.distance_rejected_count = h.distance_rejected_count
      AND m.crossings_published_count = h.crossings_published_count
)
SELECT city_slug, category, definition_version, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds,
       hour_start_utc, covered_minutes,
       distance_meters_sum,
       distinct_active_vehicle_count,
       distance_interval_count, distance_rejected_count,
       valid_active_sample_count, valid_publish_cycle_count,
       distance_meters_sum / nullif(distinct_active_vehicle_count, 0)
           AS avg_meters_per_observed_vehicle_hour,
       distance_meters_sum / nullif(distance_interval_count, 0)
           AS avg_meters_per_vehicle_update,
       active_vehicle_count_sum::numeric / nullif(valid_active_sample_count, 0)
           AS avg_active_vehicles,
       crossings_published_count AS published_crossings_per_hour
FROM verified_hours
ORDER BY hour_start_utc
    ) report
)
, matched_hours AS (
    SELECT hour_start_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds FROM reports
    GROUP BY hour_start_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
    HAVING count(DISTINCT category) = (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_categories)
), comparable AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM reports r JOIN matched_hours USING (hour_start_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds)
), policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT healthy_cadence_limit_seconds FROM reports
    UNION ALL SELECT NULL::integer WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports)
), hour_keys AS (
    SELECT hour_start_utc FROM generate_series(date_trunc('hour', ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), 'UTC'),
        date_trunc('hour', ($__timeTo()::timestamptz) - interval '1 microsecond', 'UTC'),
        interval '1 hour') AS keys(hour_start_utc)
    WHERE hour_start_utc >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND hour_start_utc + interval '1 hour' <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)
), named AS (
    SELECT selected_category AS category, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds,
        initcap(replace(selected_category, '-', ' ')) ||
        CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM policies) > 1 THEN
            ' (' || healthy_cadence_limit_seconds::text || 's policy)' ELSE '' END AS name
    FROM selected_categories CROSS JOIN policies
), period AS (
    SELECT category, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds,
        sum(distance_meters_sum) AS recorded_meters
    FROM comparable GROUP BY category, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
)
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM policies) > 1
    THEN 'Multiple collection policies' ELSE coalesce(
        to_char(sum(distance_meters_sum) / 1000, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' km',
        'No comparable hours') END AS insight FROM comparable;

           'observed-city-route-hour-statistics-v1'::text AS supported_definition, CASE ${city:sqlstring} WHEN 'atlanta' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'washington-dc' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'boston' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'new-york-city' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'toronto' THEN 'America/Toronto' WHEN 'philadelphia' THEN 'America/New_York' WHEN 'denver' THEN 'America/Denver' END::text AS local_zone
),
hours AS (
    SELECT h AS hour_start_utc,
           h >= i.from_utc AND h + interval '1 hour' <= i.to_utc AS fully_contained
    FROM (SELECT * FROM input WHERE to_utc > from_utc AND to_utc - from_utc <= interval '31 days' AND cardinality(route_keys) BETWEEN 1 AND 5) i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        date_trunc('hour', i.from_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
        i.to_utc, interval '1 hour') AS g(h)
    WHERE h < i.to_utc
),
retained AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM public.city_route_hour_statistics s
    JOIN input i ON s.city_slug = i.city_slug
    JOIN hours h USING (hour_start_utc)
),
route_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT k AS route_join_key
    FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.route_keys) AS x(k)
    WHERE i.route_keys IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT s.route_join_key
    FROM public.city_route_hour_statistics s CROSS JOIN input i
    WHERE s.city_slug = i.city_slug AND i.route_keys IS NULL
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT h.hour_start_utc, h.fully_contained,
           count(s.route_join_key) AS retained_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'Complete') AS stored_complete_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'Partial') AS stored_partial_route_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.collection_status = 'NoData') AS stored_no_data_route_count,
           coalesce(bool_or(s.has_conflict), false) AS city_hour_has_conflict,
           coalesce(bool_or(s.catalog_changed), false) AS city_hour_catalog_changed
    FROM hours h LEFT JOIN retained s USING (hour_start_utc)
    GROUP BY h.hour_start_utc, h.fully_contained
),
joined AS (
    SELECT i.city_slug AS requested_city, i.from_utc, i.to_utc,
           k.route_join_key AS requested_route_key, h.hour_start_utc AS requested_hour_utc,
           h.fully_contained, s.*,
           CASE WHEN s.hour_start_utc IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
                WHEN c.city_hour_has_conflict THEN 'Conflict'
                ELSE s.collection_status END AS effective_coverage,
           coalesce(s.definition_version = i.supported_definition, false) AS definition_compatible,
           coalesce(s.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone,
                    h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone) AS local_start,
           extract(epoch FROM ((h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE i.local_zone)
                             - (h.hour_start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')))::integer AS utc_offset_seconds
    FROM route_keys k CROSS JOIN hours h CROSS JOIN input i
    JOIN cohorts c USING (hour_start_utc)
    LEFT JOIN retained s ON s.route_join_key = k.route_join_key
                       AND s.hour_start_utc = h.hour_start_utc
),
evidence AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           effective_coverage = 'Complete' AND fully_contained AND definition_compatible
               AS contributes
    FROM joined j
), names AS (
 SELECT k.route_join_key, (ARRAY['①','②','③','④','⑤'])[row_number() OVER (ORDER BY k.route_join_key COLLATE "C")] || ' ' || coalesce(n.route_short_name,k.route_join_key) || ' [' || k.route_join_key || ']' AS label,
 row_number() OVER (ORDER BY k.route_join_key COLLATE "C") AS color_slot
 FROM route_keys k LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT nullif(route_short_name,'') AS route_short_name FROM retained r
 WHERE r.route_join_key=k.route_join_key ORDER BY hour_start_utc DESC LIMIT 1
 ) n ON true
), eligible AS (
 SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE contributes AND distinct_active_vehicle_count IS NOT NULL
), matched AS (
 SELECT requested_hour_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
 FROM eligible GROUP BY requested_hour_utc, healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
 HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM route_keys)
), fingerprints AS (
 SELECT e.requested_hour_utc, m.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.requested_route_key,e.route_catalog_fingerprint,e.category,e.route_short_name,e.static_route_id)
 ORDER BY e.requested_route_key COLLATE "C")::text AS identity
 FROM eligible e JOIN matched m USING(requested_hour_utc,healthy_cadence_limit_seconds)
 GROUP BY e.requested_hour_utc,m.healthy_cadence_limit_seconds
), changes AS (
 SELECT *, identity IS DISTINCT FROM lag(identity) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc)
 OR healthy_cadence_limit_seconds IS DISTINCT FROM lag(healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS changed
 FROM fingerprints
), segmented AS (
 SELECT *, sum(changed::integer) OVER (ORDER BY requested_hour_utc) AS segment FROM changes
), segments AS (
 SELECT segment,min(requested_hour_utc) AS start_utc,max(requested_hour_utc)+interval '1 hour' AS end_utc,
 count(*) AS hours FROM segmented GROUP BY segment
), chosen AS (
 SELECT * FROM segments WHERE segment::text = ${route_segment:sqlstring}
 OR (${route_segment:sqlstring}='latest' AND segment=(SELECT max(segment) FROM segments))
), comparable AS (
 SELECT e.*, n.label,n.color_slot FROM eligible e
 JOIN segmented s USING(requested_hour_utc,healthy_cadence_limit_seconds)
 JOIN chosen c USING(segment) JOIN names n ON n.route_join_key=e.requested_route_key
 WHERE (SELECT count(DISTINCT healthy_cadence_limit_seconds) FROM matched)=1
), period AS (
 SELECT requested_route_key,label,color_slot,count(*) AS comparable_hours,
 min(requested_hour_utc) AS first_hour,max(requested_hour_utc)+interval '1 hour' AS end_hour,
 sum(distance_meters_sum)/1000 AS recorded_km,
 sum(distinct_active_vehicle_count::numeric) AS route_vehicle_hours,
 sum(distance_interval_count) AS accepted_intervals,
 sum(crossings_published_count::numeric)/count(*) AS opportunities,
 sum(active_vehicle_count_sum::numeric)/nullif(sum(valid_active_sample_count),0) AS vehicles,
 sum(distance_meters_sum) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)/1000 AS in_service_recorded_km,
 sum(distinct_active_vehicle_count::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_route_vehicle_hours,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_hours,
 (sum(active_vehicle_count_sum::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)) /
   nullif((sum(valid_active_sample_count::numeric) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0)),0) AS in_service_vehicles,
 sum(distance_interval_count) FILTER (WHERE distinct_active_vehicle_count>0) AS in_service_accepted_intervals
 FROM comparable GROUP BY requested_route_key,label,color_slot
)
SELECT label AS route,
 (in_service_recorded_km/nullif(in_service_route_vehicle_hours,0))::double precision AS avg_km_per_vehicle_hour,
 (in_service_recorded_km/nullif(in_service_hours,0))::double precision AS avg_route_km_per_hour,
 in_service_vehicles::double precision AS vehicles,
 in_service_hours,comparable_hours,in_service_route_vehicle_hours,
 in_service_accepted_intervals,first_hour,end_hour
 FROM period WHERE in_service_hours>0 AND in_service_route_vehicle_hours>0
 ORDER BY requested_route_key COLLATE "C";
